name: Varbóc (Hungary)
description: White field with a serrated border of blue triangles, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Varbóc: a blue shield with a yellow tree, with a helm, a bird crest and grey mantling, above a scroll inscribed VARBÓC.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Varbóc arms with helm, crest, mantling and scroll
